title: MemorySearchRequest.v1
description: A request to recall/search a memory/context provider behind a Baltor wrapper. Recall returns candidate MemoryArtifacts (retrieved != served): nothing here can pull a canonical/served fact. Search is ALWAYS bounded to a (tenant_id, container) so no cross-tenant recall is possible, and uses injected time for determinism.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Required: recall is scoped to this tenant only.

container.description: Project/container scope the recall is bounded to.

search_mode.description: Mirrors the provider's hybrid/memories/documents modes. Provider-agnostic; the wrapper maps it.

now.description: Injected time for the recall (deterministic; no wall-clock).
